features.title: Entrepreneurship PNP
features.description: PNPs in Canada offer a great path for entrepreneurs to invest and start a business. Each province has unique criteria, and with our expertise, we help you choose the right program, prepare documents, and complete the process—leading to a successful business and permanent residency.

ourTeamText: Our team of experts is comprised of professionals who are passionate about their work, and have an extensive background in a wide variety of applications, and are willing to help at any time
PartnersDescription: At NovaNest Venture, we welcome strategic affiliations with international firms and qualified influencers alike. As an approved affiliate, you will receive co-branded support and future representations that wield substantial influence within the business landscape. To become an affiliate, please complete our free questionnaire for our confidential review.
AboutUsContent: We are a network of international investors, serial entrepreneurs, and skilled professionals who support startups and businesses in transforming their ideas into reality or scaling their existing ventures. Our goal is to help them scale up so they can offer their products or services on a global level

cards.title: Investment
cards.text: At NovaNest Investment Center, we focus on investing in innovative and scalable startups with international market potential and a valuation of $5 million or less. As a network of experienced angel investors, we provide not only initial funding but also strategic support in capital raising and connections to a global network of investors. Our goal is to accelerate your growth, strengthen your presence in international markets, and enhance the overall value of your business.

cards.title: Acceleration
cards.text: At NovaNest Acceleration Center, we empower innovative startups to grow from idea to global success. Our accelerator provides mentorship, training, networking, and access to investors, helping entrepreneurs develop products, enter new markets, and achieve rapid growth. We focus on sectors such as Artificial Intelligence, Tourism, and Education, supporting startups in creating lasting impact on a global scale.

NovaNestAcademyInfo: At NovaNest, we provide a nurturing place for individuals to discover and grow their interests and skills efficiently. Our academy operates as a dynamic environment that identifies and evaluates the potential of talented individuals, particularly the youth, and invests in their development and creative ideas. By providing comprehensive programs and resources, and through a combination of mentoring, skill-building workshops, and exposure to various opportunities, NovaNest Academy equips participants with the tools and knowledge necessary to thrive and succeed in their chosen fields.

specialFeatureCards.title: Mentorship
specialFeatureCards.subtitle: Join as a Mentor
specialFeatureCards.text: Join our network of experienced mentors and help shape the future of innovative startups. Share your expertise, grow your professional network, and make a real impact—while enjoying financial rewards, career growth, and exclusive opportunities.
benefits: Meaningful impact on startups and society
Exclusive access to events and resources

specialFeatureCards.title: Trainee
specialFeatureCards.subtitle: Join as a Trainee
specialFeatureCards.text: Start your journey with NovaNest as a trainee and learn directly from mentors and startup teams. Gain hands-on experience, explore entrepreneurship, and build the skills you need to grow into a future founder or professional leader.
benefits: Real-world learning alongside mentors and startup teams
Practical training in entrepreneurship and business development
Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals
Completion Certificate & career paths at NovaNest
